Manhattan Building Evacuated After Structural Columns Buckle

A high-rise building in Manhattan, New York, was evacuated after its structural columns buckled, leading officials to warn of a potential collapse. Nearby buildings, including the Indian UN Mission and a school with hundreds of children, were also evacuated as a precaution. The situation was described as "extremely serious" by the New York Mayor, who stated the building remains unstable.
